worker_enroll_command_description: Run this on the Worker and paste the token when asked.
worker_enroll_name_description: Letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, for example the Worker's name.
worker_enroll_shown_once: Shown only this once. Anyone with the token can act as this Worker.
worker_remove_description: Its token stops working at once, and the work it holds returns to the queue. Enroll it again to reconnect the Worker.
workers_empty_description_admin: Enroll a Worker, then run the setup command on it.
workers_empty_description_member: An administrator enrolls the Workers that run detection and training.
